spaces.title: Multi-Space Isolation
spaces.description: Keep your workflows cleanly separated. Each workspace (Personal, Work, Ghost, Tor) maintains its own completely isolated logins, cookies, and tabs so work never bleeds into personal browsing.

splitview.description: Browse two websites simultaneously side-by-side without opening separate windows. Perfect for research, coding with documentation open, or comparing items side-by-side.

tor.title: Built-in Tor Onion Network
tor.description: Browse the decentralized web with built-in multi-hop circuit encryption. QBrowse routes your connection through encrypted Tor relays to access .onion domains without third-party proxies.
tor.missionInstruction: Click the Tor Network icon on the top bar to inspect your active relay circuit
tor.missionSuccess: Tor circuit open! You can see your multi-hop relay nodes and toggle onion routing at any time.

vault.title: Zero-Knowledge QVault
vault.description: Your master passwords, passkeys, and credit card autofills are encrypted directly on your device using local hardware keys and {biometric} biometric security. Zero plain text ever leaves your PC.
vault.missionInstruction: Click the QVault icon on the top bar to open your local QVault
vault.missionSuccess: QVault opened! All stored credentials are encrypted locally on your hardware with biometric protection.

shield.title: Native Ad & Tracker Interceptor
shield.description: Hardware-accelerated native network blocking stops third-party telemetry, crypto-miners, fingerprinting scripts, and intrusive ads before network packets even reach your computer.
shield.missionInstruction: Click the Shield icon on the top bar to inspect blocked trackers and protection rules
shield.missionSuccess: QShield inspector open! You can view live blocked telemetry domains and toggle the interceptor.

darkmode.title: Smart Dark Mode & System Themes
darkmode.description: Effortlessly tailor your visual aesthetics. Switch between sleek dark themes, crisp light mode, or toggle Smart Invert to force high-contrast dark styles across legacy bright websites.

darkmode.missionSuccess: Theme panel opened! You can toggle between dark, light, and smart invert modes.

prefer-high-performance-gpu.name: Prefer High-Performance GPU
prefer-high-performance-gpu.description: Directs WebGL, Canvas, and 3D rendering to the dedicated GPU on systems with multiple graphics cards. Automatically disabled in Eco Saver mode to conserve battery.

unlock-frame-rate.name: Unlocked Frame Rate (Benchmark Mode)
unlock-frame-rate.description: Disables V-Sync and framerate limits for synthetic canvas/WebGL FPS benchmarks (e.g. xbitlabs, TestUFO). May cause screen tearing and higher power consumption in regular browsing.

ignore-gpu-blocklist.name: Ignore GPU Blocklist
ignore-gpu-blocklist.description: Overrides Chromium built-in software rendering lists and enables hardware acceleration on older or unclassified graphics drivers.

experimental-web-platform.name: Experimental Web Platform Features
experimental-web-platform.description: Enables experimental web platform features under development in Chromium. Increases compatibility score on HTML5Test; some cutting-edge APIs may be unstable.

gpu-rasterization.name: GPU Rasterization & Compositor Acceleration
gpu-rasterization.description: Accelerates web page rasterization and compositing using dedicated hardware GPU pipelines instead of CPU software rendering.

smooth-scrolling.name: Smooth Scrolling Engine
smooth-scrolling.description: Enables fluid physical cubic-bezier easing animations when scrolling page contents via mouse wheel, touchpad, or arrow keys.

zero-copy-rasterizer.name: Zero-Copy GPU Rasterizer (GpuMemoryBuffer)
zero-copy-rasterizer.description: Raster workers write directly into shared GPU textures without CPU memory staging copies, reducing memory bus contention.

enable-vulkan.name: Vulkan Graphics & Compositing Backend
enable-vulkan.description: Uses the Vulkan cross-platform graphics API for GPU compositing, rendering pipelines, and driver interop on supported GPUs.

back-forward-cache.name: Back-forward Cache (bfcache)
back-forward-cache.description: Preserves complete in-memory execution snapshots of recently visited web pages for instantaneous back and forward navigations.

canvas-oop-rasterization.name: Out-of-Process 2D Canvas Rasterization
canvas-oop-rasterization.description: Performs HTML5 2D Canvas rendering operations in the dedicated GPU process rather than the sandboxed renderer process.

enable-drdc.name: Dynamic High Refresh Rate Detection (120Hz/144Hz/240Hz)
enable-drdc.description: Synchronizes frame pacing and V-Sync intervals to adapt dynamically to ProMotion and high-refresh gaming displays.

auto-suspend-tabs.name: Auto-Suspend Memory Saver (V8 GC Throttling)
auto-suspend-tabs.description: Automatically unloads inactive background tabs after 15 minutes of inactivity to dramatically conserve RAM and battery life.

parallel-download-engine.name: Parallel Multi-Threaded Range Downloads
parallel-download-engine.description: Splits large file downloads into multiple parallel HTTP range requests to maximize bandwidth utilization and transfer speed.

lazy-image-loading.name: Lazy Image & Embedded Frame Loading
lazy-image-loading.description: Defers loading of off-screen images and third-party iframes until they are scrolled into view, reducing initial page payload.

enable-tls13-kyber.name: Post-Quantum Cryptography for TLS (Kyber768 / ML-KEM)
enable-tls13-kyber.description: Enables quantum-resistant hybrid key encapsulation (X25519Kyber768) in TLS 1.3 handshakes to protect traffic against future quantum decryption.

enable-encrypted-client-hello.name: Encrypted Client Hello (ECH / Encrypted SNI)
enable-encrypted-client-hello.description: Encrypts the Server Name Indication (SNI) inside TLS handshakes, preventing ISPs, firewalls, and network snoops from seeing visited domain names.

strict-origin-isolation.name: Strict Origin Site-Per-Process Sandboxing
strict-origin-isolation.description: Enforces dedicated OS processes with isolated virtual memory addresses for every distinct origin, mitigating Spectre and Meltdown exploits.

webrtc-ip-protection.name: WebRTC Local IP Address & STUN Leak Concealment
webrtc-ip-protection.description: Restricts WebRTC ICE candidates to non-proxied UDP endpoints, preventing malicious scripts from enumerating your true local LAN or public IP.

enable-dns-over-https.name: Strict DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH Cloudflare/Quad9)
enable-dns-over-https.description: Encrypts all recursive DNS lookups over HTTPS (port 443) to block ISP eavesdropping, DNS hijacking, and domain poisoning.

disable-hyperlink-auditing.name: Disable Hyperlink Auditing (<a ping>) & Beacon Pings
disable-hyperlink-auditing.description: Blocks websites from silently dispatching tracking POST requests when user clicks hyperlinks, neutralizing outbound ad tracking beacons.

enable-fingerprint-randomization.name: HTML5 Canvas & WebAudio Fingerprint Noise Injection
enable-fingerprint-randomization.description: Subtly perturbs pixel readback and audio buffer values with cryptographic pseudorandom noise to prevent unique hardware device fingerprinting.

enable-font-enumeration-shield.name: Local Font Enumeration & Query Shield
enable-font-enumeration-shield.description: Prevents web applications from probing locally installed system fonts to assemble persistent cross-browser identity hashes.

aggressive-tracker-blocker.name: Aggressive Ad & URL Parameter Stripping Engine
aggressive-tracker-blocker.description: Strips telemetry tracking query parameters (utm_source, gclid, fbclid, msclkid) and blocks known tracking pixels across all navigation requests.

enable-subresource-filter.name: Subresource Filter for Abusive & Deceptive Interstitials
enable-subresource-filter.description: Automatically detects and suppresses clickjackers, invisible overlay links, and deceptive download prompts on untrusted websites.

enable-quic.name: Experimental QUIC & HTTP/3 Transport Protocol
enable-quic.description: Enables UDP-based HTTP/3 transport for zero-RTT handshakes, forward error correction, and multiplexed stream delivery without head-of-line blocking.

tor-stream-isolation.name: Tor Per-Domain Stream Circuit Isolation (IsolateDestAddr)
tor-stream-isolation.description: Forces each unique top-level domain in Tor Space to traverse a distinct exit circuit, preventing cross-site correlation and exit-node tracking.

dns-prefetching.name: Predictive DNS Pre-Resolution Engine
dns-prefetching.description: Proactively resolves IP addresses for anchor links visible on the current page to eliminate DNS resolution latency upon clicking.

heavy-ad-intervention.name: Heavy Network Ad Resource Intervention
heavy-ad-intervention.description: Unloads advertising iframes that consume more than 4MB of network bandwidth or 60 seconds of CPU execution time.

cross-origin-isolation.name: Cross-Origin Opener Policy (COOP) & SharedArrayBuffer
cross-origin-isolation.description: Enables high-precision WebAssembly shared memory operations by strictly enforcing Cross-Origin Opener and Embedder policies.

document-pip-api.name: Document Picture-in-Picture API
document-pip-api.description: Enables floating picture-in-picture windows populated with arbitrary HTML documents, video streams, custom player controls, and widgets.

force-dark-contents.name: Auto Dark Mode for Web Contents (Chromium Inversion)
force-dark-contents.description: Automatically synthesizes a dark theme for websites that only support light backgrounds using luminance-preserving color inversion.

overlay-scrollbars.name: Minimalist Floating Overlay Scrollbars
overlay-scrollbars.description: Replaces chunky OS scrollbars with sleek floating scroll indicators that automatically fade out when scrolling stops.

enable-webgpu.name: Next-Generation WebGPU Graphics & Compute API
enable-webgpu.description: Provides low-overhead, direct GPU access for in-browser neural networks, 3D simulations, and shader computations.

tab-audio-muting.name: One-Click Tab Audio Muting Indicator
tab-audio-muting.description: Adds an interactive audio speaker badge to active tab buttons, allowing immediate tab audio muting with a single click.

webrtc-pipewire.name: PipeWire Desktop Capturer (Linux Wayland)
webrtc-pipewire.description: Enables screen sharing and window capture via PipeWire portal on modern Linux desktop environments (GNOME, KDE Plasma).

hdr-compositing.name: High Dynamic Range (HDR) Color Compositing
hdr-compositing.description: Enables 10-bit wide color gamut (Rec.2020 / DCI-P3) and HDR tone mapping on compatible OLED and mini-LED displays.

local-ai-assistant.name: Local GGUF LLM VRAM Acceleration (llama.cpp)
local-ai-assistant.description: Offloads on-device Gemma and Llama 3 model weights directly to GPU VRAM for private, low-latency summarization and querying.

experimental-split-screen-gestures.name: Kinetic Split Screen Panes & Snap Gestures
experimental-split-screen-gestures.description: Allows dragging tabs to viewport edges to instantly create responsive horizontal or vertical dual-pane browsing sessions.

enable-reader-mode.name: Distraction-Free Article Reader Mode
enable-reader-mode.description: Extracts article text and typography into a high-legibility layout, eliminating sidebars, advertisements, and page clutter.

auto-password-generation.name: Cryptographic Strong Password Generation
auto-password-generation.description: Automatically detects new account registration forms and proposes 128-bit cryptographically secure passwords backed by QVault.

tab-groups-auto-clustering.name: Smart Domain & Workspace Tab Clustering
tab-groups-auto-clustering.description: Intelligently suggests grouping open tabs based on shared origin domains and temporal workspace usage patterns.

touch-ui-layout.name: Touchscreen Tablet UI Mode
touch-ui-layout.description: Expands tab bar heights and hit-testing margins for touch-first convertibles. Currently disabled on desktop keyboard/mouse profiles.

eye-tracking-gaze-scroll.name: Eye-Tracking Gaze Navigation
eye-tracking-gaze-scroll.description: Controls viewport scrolling based on pupil gaze coordinates. Requires specialized infrared hardware sensors.

cellular-data-saver.name: Cellular Metered Data Saver
cellular-data-saver.description: Compresses remote images via upstream proxy gateways. Disabled for privacy to prevent remote proxy decryption.
cellular-data-saver.reason: Disabled by default to preserve Tor and HTTPS end-to-end privacy.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.subtitle: Customize visual contrast, dyslexia typography, vestibular comfort, and navigation aids.
accessibility.visualSectionDesc: High-contrast legibility, specialized typeface, minimum text sizing, and page scale.
accessibility.highContrastDesc: Amplifies text luminance, defines stark contrast boundaries, and strips soft shadows across the QBrowse interface and web pages.
accessibility.dyslexiaDesc: Applies gravity-weighted OpenDyslexic typography with increased letter spacing to combat letter flipping and improve reading comprehension.
accessibility.minTextSizeDesc: Enforces an absolute lower bound on font size so small captions and body text remain clearly readable.
accessibility.pageZoomDesc: Base magnification scale applied across tabs. Standard baseline is 100%.
accessibility.motionSectionDesc: Protect against motion sickness and vestibular strain by suppressing rapid animations.
accessibility.reducedMotionForced: Reduced motion is manually forced on. Browser interface transitions, Tab Map 3D tilt, and web animations are suppressed.
accessibility.reducedMotionSysDarwin: macOS Reduce Motion is currently turned on in System Settings. Transitions and animations are automatically suppressed to match macOS.
accessibility.reducedMotionSysLinux: System Accessibility animations are currently turned off in your OS. Transitions and animations are automatically suppressed to match your desktop settings.
accessibility.reducedMotionSysWin: Windows Accessibility animations are currently turned off in your OS. Transitions and animations are automatically suppressed to match Windows.
accessibility.reducedMotionDefDarwin: Disables browser interface transitions, suppresses parallax scrolling, and instructs websites to halt decorative animations. Automatically syncs with macOS Reduce Motion.
accessibility.reducedMotionDefLinux: Disables browser interface transitions, suppresses parallax scrolling, and instructs websites to halt decorative animations. Automatically syncs with OS Animation Effects.
accessibility.reducedMotionDefWin: Disables browser interface transitions, suppresses parallax scrolling, and instructs websites to halt decorative animations. Automatically syncs with Windows Animation Effects.
accessibility.autoplayDesc: Prevents background video elements and HTML5 audiovisual streams from auto-playing without explicit user initiation.
accessibility.keyboardSectionDesc: Independent keyboard operation, high-visibility focus indicators, and text caret browsing.
accessibility.caretDesc: Place a moveable typing cursor on any web page to select text, scroll, and navigate purely via arrow keys. Press F7 at any time.
accessibility.focusRingsDesc: Renders a high-contrast 3px glowing amber border around whichever link, button, or input currently holds keyboard focus.
accessibility.audioSectionDesc: Text-to-speech engine, automatic video subtitles, and mono audio downmixing.
accessibility.readAloudDesc: Launches the dedicated text-to-speech toolbar to read web articles, news, or selected text with synchronized speech.
accessibility.captionsDesc: Automatically instructs HTML5 video players to activate native closed caption and subtitle text tracks by default.
accessibility.monoAudioDesc: Combines left and right stereo audio channels into both ears to ensure no content is missed for users with unilateral hearing.
